description: Magic Bounce (onTryHit, priority 1): Sableye's Prankster Thunder Wave on Hatterene is bounced back at Sableye with the original +1 priority but without the Prankster boost, so the Dark type is not immune (90% accuracy rolls again); Jolteon's Growl is bounced back at both foes by Hatterene and still lowers Snorlax. Hatterene and Snorlax Harden.
